summary: Evaluates common claims about improving peer selection in peer-to-peer applications, such as preferring nearby peers. It separates the myths from what holds up and discusses the benefits and limits of locality-aware selection. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Do you get your game cards faster by trading with friends who live next door? This checks which popular beliefs are true and which are just stories.

questions: does locality aware peer selection help p2p
peer to peer myths vs reality
